records.singular: Controlling enough industry to jumpstart a new country, Balthazar kept working on building more industry, and more machines.  Eventually they started a serious effort at wiping out all causes of zombies around their area.  Even after many years you can see the robots fight an endless war…
records.en: Controlling enough industry to jumpstart a new country, Balthazar kept working on building more industry, and more machines.  Eventually they started a serious effort at wiping out all causes of zombies around their area.  Even after many years you can see the robots fight an endless war…
records.ja: 新たな国家を立ち上げられるほどの生産力を掌握したバルタザールは、生産設備と機械をさらに増やし続けた。やがて周辺地域でゾンビを生み出すあらゆる原因を根絶するべく、本格的な取り組みを始めた。何年経っても、果てしない戦争を続けるロボットたちの姿が見られる…

records.singular: Having amassed a big corporation's worth of industry, Balthazar succeeded in some of their goals and started wiping out their enemies.  Sadly they couldn't keep up with the ever-changing enemies and eventually ran out of resources through attrition…
records.en: Having amassed a big corporation's worth of industry, Balthazar succeeded in some of their goals and started wiping out their enemies.  Sadly they couldn't keep up with the ever-changing enemies and eventually ran out of resources through attrition…
records.ja: 大企業に匹敵する生産力を蓄えたバルタザールは、目標の一部を達成し、敵を掃討し始めた。しかし、絶えず変化する敵にはついていけず、消耗を重ねた末に資源が尽きてしまった…

records.singular: Struggling for resources, Balthazar sacrificed a lot to get into a position where they could expand.  Ultimately the sacrifices were too great for them to achieve their goals and their bunker was eventually overrun…
records.en: Struggling for resources, Balthazar sacrificed a lot to get into a position where they could expand.  Ultimately the sacrifices were too great for them to achieve their goals and their bunker was eventually overrun…
records.ja: 資源の確保に苦しみながら、バルタザールは勢力を拡大できるようになるまで多くの犠牲を払った。だが、その犠牲は目標を達成するには大きすぎ、やがて掩体壕は敵に蹂躙された…

records.singular: Be extra careful on roads.  They are easy to travel on, but occasional road blocks can make you feel sorry in an instant.
records.en: Be extra careful on roads.  They are easy to travel on, but occasional road blocks can make you feel sorry in an instant.
records.ja: 道路では特に注意しよう。移動しやすいが、ときどきある道路封鎖で一瞬にして痛い目を見ることもある。

records.singular:
There were among our men those who asked whether it was all not a dream.  How else could one explain the glimpse of things never heard of, never seen, and never even conceived of before.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - recovered from the log of ESS Firebird.
records.en:
There were among our men those who asked whether it was all not a dream.  How else could one explain the glimpse of things never heard of, never seen, and never even conceived of before.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - recovered from the log of ESS Firebird.
records.ja:
仲間の中には、すべて夢なのではないかと問う者もいた。これまで聞いたことも、見たことも、想像したことすらないものを垣間見た経験を、他にどう説明できようか。
<color_c_dark_gray>  - ESSファイアバードの航海日誌から回収された記録。

<color_c_dark_gray>  -"The Highlands of Aztlan" holodoc
records.en:

<color_c_dark_gray>  -"The Highlands of Aztlan" holodoc
records.ja:
数か月ごとに、この惑星は巨大な残骸群を横切る。断絶が起きた頃の古い戦場の跡だ。地元の人々は盛大に祝う。大狩猟の幕開けを告げるんだ。
<color_c_dark_gray>  -「アストランの高地」ホログラム記録映像

records.singular:
Mostly, it makes me feel very small, like when I was a kid playing with my father's tools.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - "Life in the Tenellus Frontier", interview with mercenary captain, c2514.
records.en:
Mostly, it makes me feel very small, like when I was a kid playing with my father's tools.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - "Life in the Tenellus Frontier", interview with mercenary captain, c2514.
records.ja:
たいてい、自分がひどく小さく感じるんだ。子供の頃、父親の道具で遊んでいた時みたいに。
<color_c_dark_gray>  - 「テネラス辺境での暮らし」、傭兵隊長へのインタビュー、2514年頃。

records.singular:
I try not to think about what it actually means, none of us do really.  Otherwise it would drive us mad with grief.  [Laughs] Still drives some mad though, I guess.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - "Life in the Tenellus Frontier", interview with salvor guild journeyman, c2514.
records.en:
I try not to think about what it actually means, none of us do really.  Otherwise it would drive us mad with grief.  [Laughs] Still drives some mad though, I guess.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - "Life in the Tenellus Frontier", interview with salvor guild journeyman, c2514.
records.ja:
それが実際には何を意味するのか、考えないようにしている。みんなそうさ。そうしなきゃ、悲しみで気が狂っちまう。[笑い] それでも狂っちまう奴はいるけどな。
<color_c_dark_gray>  - 「テネラス辺境での生活」、サルベージ業者ギルドの職人へのインタビュー、2514年頃。

records.singular:
We had those at home too, on summer days we'd chase frogs through the pipes and into the coolant chambers deep below them.  I remember the em-lights still glittering in the immense halls, it was like a secret night sky sealed away.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - overheard in Port Augustmoon.
records.en:
We had those at home too, on summer days we'd chase frogs through the pipes and into the coolant chambers deep below them.  I remember the em-lights still glittering in the immense halls, it was like a secret night sky sealed away.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - overheard in Port Augustmoon.
records.ja:
故郷にもああいうのがあった。夏の日には、パイプの中から、そのずっと下にある冷却室までカエルを追いかけたものだ。広大なホールでは、電磁灯がまだきらめいていたのを覚えている。封じ込められた秘密の夜空みたいだった。
<color_c_dark_gray>  - オーガストムーン宇宙港で耳にした話。

records.singular:
At night, both water and carbon dioxide freeze in the upper atmosphere, such that every dawn is accompanied by a procession of colorful haloes over the horizon.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - Salus IV rediscovery report 02.11.2428, submitted by Cpt.  Jean McAllister.
records.en:
At night, both water and carbon dioxide freeze in the upper atmosphere, such that every dawn is accompanied by a procession of colorful haloes over the horizon.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - Salus IV rediscovery report 02.11.2428, submitted by Cpt.  Jean McAllister.
records.ja:
夜になると上層大気では水も二酸化炭素も凍りつく。そのため、夜明けのたびに色とりどりの光輪が地平線に連なる。
<color_c_dark_gray>  - サルスIV再発見報告書、02.11.2428、ジャン・マカリスター船長提出。

records.singular:
&The food stall is a colorful array of various dishes, and the smell of spices and cooked meats cuts easily through the frozen air.  The vendor  is busy preparing a meal when you approach.
"Oh steemd do you see anything you like?"
records.en:
&The food stall is a colorful array of various dishes, and the smell of spices and cooked meats cuts easily through the frozen air.  The vendor  is busy preparing a meal when you approach.
"Oh steemd do you see anything you like?"
records.ja:
&屋台には色とりどりの料理が並び、香辛料と焼けた肉の匂いが凍てつく空気の中でもはっきりと漂っています。近づくと、商人は忙しそうに食事を準備しています。
「おお、お客さん。気に入ったものはあるかい？」

records.singular:
&The vendor chuckles at your question, wiping his hands on his apron.
Safe?  Yes very safe steemd, snow dry and clean steemd.  In home we do not have so much snow, but here it is very good for food.
records.en:
&The vendor chuckles at your question, wiping his hands on his apron.
Safe?  Yes very safe steemd, snow dry and clean steemd.  In home we do not have so much snow, but here it is very good for food.
records.ja:
&商人はあなたの質問にくすっと笑い、エプロンで手を拭きます。
安全かって？ ああ、とても安全だよ、お客さん。雪は乾いていてきれいなんだ、お客さん。故郷にはこんなに雪はなかったが、ここの雪は料理にとても良いんだ。
